These are guesses. I can't see which verbs the first page defines (`filter`, `groupBy`, `sortBy`, `mapVals`, `split`, `default` and the like), so I wrote them as plausible names and none of them are checked against the language.

H1: filter (/active | eq true) | filter (/country | lower | eq "de") | filter (/age | gte 30 !| false) | * /name | sort
H2: filter (/status | lower | eq "paid") | * (/items * (/qty | mul /price)) | flat | sum | round 2
H3: groupBy (/customer | lower) | mapVals count
H4: {:name /name :depCount (/dependencies | count) :devDepCount (/devDependencies | count) :scripts (/scripts | keys | sort)}
H5: filter (/state | eq "open") | sortBy /id | sortBy (/comments | neg) | take 3 * /id
H6: * (/labels !| []) | flat | * lower | distinct | sort
H7: filter (/state | eq "open") | groupBy (/assignee/login !| "unassigned") | mapVals count
H8: split "\n" | filter (trim | ne "") | * (split " ") | filter (/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy /2 | mapVals count
H9: split "\n" | filter (trim | ne "") | * (split " ") | filter (/1 | in ["ERROR" "WARN"]) | * (drop 3) | flat | filter (startsWith "user=") | * (replace "user=" "") | distinct | sort
H10: split "\n" | drop 1 | filter (trim | ne "") | * (split ",") | filter (/4 | lower | eq "up") | filter (/2 | ne "") | groupBy /1 | mapVals (* (/2 | num) | avg | round 1)
H11: split "\n" | filter (trim | ne "") | filter (startsWith "#" | not) | * (splitOnce "=") | filter (/0 | lower | startsWith "db_") | * [(/0 | lower | drop 3) /1] | toObject
H12: :d /defaults/timeout | /services | filter (/enabled | eq true) | * {:name /name :timeout (/timeout | default d) :team (/owner/team !| "none")} | sortBy /name
H13: /results | filter (/score | gte 50 !| false) | sortBy /score | reverse | * (/profile/first | add " " | add /profile/last | add ": " | add (/tags !| [] | join "|"))
H14: lower | split "[^a-z]+" | filter (ne "") | groupBy id | mapVals count | entries * {:word /0 :count /1} | sortBy /word | sortBy (/count | neg) | take 3
